zh: 先看目標為 1 時平方誤差的曲線在輸出趨近 0 時只升到 0.499；再看另一條 −ln ŷ 的曲線一路飆到 6.908；右邊是平方誤差的兩個毛病：不公平與會卡住。〔功能：1、2〕
目標為 1 時兩種損失對輸出 ŷ 的變化：ŷ = 0.001 時平方誤差 0.499、−ln ŷ 為 6.908。
en: First see the squared-error curve for target 1 rise only to 0.499 as the output approaches 0; then see the other curve, −ln ŷ, shoot up to 6.908; the right side lists the two faults of the squared error: unfair and getting stuck. [Function: 1, 2]
The two losses against the output ŷ for target 1: at ŷ = 0.001 the squared error is 0.499 and −ln ŷ is 6.908.

zh: 先看 net 很負或很正時 δ 幾乎為 0（兩側的高原）；再看只有中間一小段 δ 夠大；右邊是公式 δ = (y − ŷ)ŷ(1 − ŷ)，與 net = −10 時 δ = 0.000045。〔功能：2〕
平方誤差的 δ 對 net（目標 1）：兩側是高原，net = −10 時 δ 只有 0.000045。
en: First see δ almost 0 when net is very negative or very positive (the plateaus on both sides); then see that only a small middle stretch has a large δ; the right gives the formula δ = (y − ŷ)ŷ(1 − ŷ) and δ = 0.000045 at net = −10. [Function: 2]
Squared-error δ against net (target 1): plateaus on both sides, and only 0.000045 at net = −10.

zh: 先看左邊交叉熵的三步推導：偏微分、sigmoid 斜率、連鎖律相乘後 ŷ(1 − ŷ) 約掉；再看右邊 y = 1 時 net 從 −10 到 5 的兩種 δ：交叉熵的 δ 不被壓小。〔功能：2〕
交叉熵的三步推導與 net = −10 到 5 時兩種 δ 的對照：net = −10 時 0.00005 對 1.0000。
en: First see the three-step derivation of the cross-entropy on the left: the partial derivative, the sigmoid slope, and the chain rule where ŷ(1 − ŷ) cancels; then see the two δ for y = 1 and net from −10 to 5 on the right: the cross-entropy δ is not squeezed. [Function: 2]
The three-step derivation for the cross-entropy and the two δ for net = −10 to 5: 0.00005 against 1.0000 at net = −10.

zh: 先看 x = 2 的輸出隨 epoch 上升：交叉熵在第 5 個 epoch 過 0.5，平方誤差要到第 85 個；右邊是實驗設定與常見迷思。〔功能：2〕
x = 2 的輸出對 epoch：交叉熵 5 個 epoch、平方誤差 85 個 epoch 四點全對。
en: First see the output at x = 2 rise with the epoch: the cross-entropy passes 0.5 at epoch 5 and the squared error only at epoch 85; the right shows the setup and the common myth. [Function: 2]
The output at x = 2 against the epoch: all four points are right after 5 epochs for the cross-entropy and 85 for the squared error.

zh: 先看左邊四筆資料：輸出、目標、目標的機率與 −ln；再看兩條綠色結果：四筆相乘 0.4536、−ln = 0.7905，與四筆交叉熵加總相同。〔功能：2〕
四筆資料的概似：機率相乘 0.4536，−ln 0.4536 = 0.7905，等於四筆交叉熵加總。
en: First see the four samples on the left: output, target, probability of the target and −ln; then see the two green results: the product 0.4536 and −ln = 0.7905 equal the sum of the four cross-entropies. [Function: 2]
Likelihood of four samples: the probabilities multiply to 0.4536 and −ln 0.4536 = 0.7905, equal to the sum of the four cross-entropies.

zh: 先看 v 的三根長條，再看 softmax 後的 ŷ（加起來為 1），最後看 δ（目標那一類為正、其餘為負）；右邊是一步一步的算式。〔功能：1、2〕
en: First see the three bars of v, then ŷ after the softmax (summing to 1), and finally δ (positive for the target class, negative for the rest); the right shows the step-by-step calculation. [Function: 1, 2]

zh: 先看左圖離群點 x = 40 把最小平方直線拉平；再看右邊放大的兩條邊界：平方誤差的切在 1.40（x = 1 分錯）、交叉熵的切在 0。〔功能：1、3〕
離群點拉歪邊界：平方誤差的切點 1.40、交叉熵的切點約 0。
en: First see the outlier x = 40 flatten the least-squares line in the left chart; then see the two boundaries in the zoom on the right: the squared-error cut at 1.40 (x = 1 wrong) and the cross-entropy cut at 0. [Function: 1, 3]
The outlier bends the boundary: squared-error cut at 1.40, cross-entropy cut near 0.

zh: 先看 n = 0 的寬鐘形（先驗），再看 n 增加時鐘形變窄、中心移向 1.5；右邊是後驗標準差與平均的表。〔功能：1、2〕
en: First see the wide bell of n = 0 (the prior), then see the bell narrow and its centre move toward 1.5 as n grows; the right gives the table of posterior standard deviation and mean. [Function: 1, 2]
The posterior: for n = 0, 1, 5, 20 the standard deviation is 2, 0.894, 0.436, 0.222 and the mean 0, 1.2, 1.43, 1.48.

zh: 先看對數座標上平方誤差的點一路爬升，再看交叉熵的點幾乎平躺；右邊說明為什麼差距越拉越大。〔功能：2〕
起點越錯所需的 epoch 數：w = −10 時平方誤差 88,141 個、交叉熵 14 個。
en: First see the squared-error points climb on the log scale, then see the cross-entropy points stay almost flat; the right explains why the gap keeps growing. [Function: 2]
Epochs needed as the start gets worse: at w = −10, 88,141 for the squared error and 14 for the cross-entropy.

zh: 左邊是題 1：net = −4 時 ŷ = 0.0180；右邊是題 2：平方誤差 δ = 0.01735、交叉熵 δ = 0.9820，倍數 56.6，各附核對。〔功能：3〕
兩題小練習與解題示範：ŷ = 0.0180；兩種 δ 的倍數 56.6。
en: The left is Q1: ŷ = 0.0180 at net = −4; the right is Q2: squared-error δ = 0.01735, cross-entropy δ = 0.9820 and a factor of 56.6, each with its check. [Function: 3]
Two exercises with worked answers: ŷ = 0.0180 and a δ ratio of 56.6.
